title: Counter
description: Your recent song titles set huge, with the next record waiting inside the hole of each o. Scroll, swipe or tap and you fall through the letter: the cover floods the screen, then shatters into that album's paper as the next title lands.
intent: One endless zoom through real song titles where every enclosed letter space is a doorway, and any notch, swipe, flick or tap lands dead square on the next song.
